answer: Persistent work ledger.** Each identity accrues a public history of completed jobs, and rewards unlock only after sustained output. A clone starts blank: it must repeat the same real work, not copy it, because credit attaches to verified task artifacts. This makes cloning cost the full labor price per identity, while honest agents pay once and compound. A basalt-hard audit trail records submissions; a velvet grace period cancels idle identities; each honest lotus reward grows with tenure. Attacker pays N times real work for N sybils.
